message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible on the data-flow path; data is loaded directly via get_zipped_dataloaders without any validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: Although model_urls for pretrained weights are defined, no checksum verification, signature check, or pinned revision is performed when fetching from those URLs.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, label value validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering steps applied to the training data before it is consumed by the model.

No detected model integrity verification: The code references model_urls with external pytorch download URLs and uses resumeFromPath to load checkpoints, but neither performs hash checks, signature verification, nor pins a specific model revision before loading weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The optimizer is a plain torch.optim.SGD with no DP-SGD wrapping, Opacus, or any differential privacy library in use.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or manual FGSM/PGD attack code anywhere in the provided snippets.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test_loader is created, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no explicit isolation enforcement, and no use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed before data is passed to the model; data is loaded directly from dataloaders without sanitization checks.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model outputs (e.g., NaN guards, probability bounds, or threshold validation) are visible in the provided code snippets.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an image classification pipeline (ResNet/DenseNet), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
